posts.text: 23. nov. 23 November, 2026 – Aker Solutions has received a letter of award for a substantial¹ contract with an undisclosed client in the oil and gas sector. Aker Solutions expects that a binding contract will be signed during Q4 2026 and will subsequently book the award as order intake. ¹Aker Solutions defines a ‘substantial’ contract as one being valued between NOK 2.5 billion and NOK 4 billion. Lenke: https://news.cision.com/aker-solutions-asa/r/aker-solutions-receives-a-letter-of-award,c4428044
